# go list -export of a main package with a default.pgo compiles its packages
# with that profile, so a build afterwards reuses every compile.

[short] skip

env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

go list -export -deps -f '{{if false}}{{end}}' m/a
go build -x -o $WORK/a.exe m/a
! stderr '-p m/b '
! stderr '-p m/a '

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.23
-- a/a.go --
package main

import _ "m/b"

func main() {}
-- a/default.pgo --
-- b/b.go --
package b
